spec.kitLine: last bullet → Crit Rate of normal atks ▲
spec.assertion: Structural: trigger lastBullet / target allies / stat critRateNormalPct 14.64 / durationSec 5, no durationShots. Behavioural: buffApply events with stat 'critRateNormalPct' value 14.64 exist and target all three allies — RED under the nearest-wrong unscoped critRatePct model (that filter goes EMPTY), which would also over-credit the 8236.8% burst nuke and the 178.98% rider. Non-vacuity: applies×5s < 180s proves the window has real downtime.
Re-target to {kind:'self'} → liter and crown lose damage vs base. RED under a self-scoped model; teammate totals are nonzero in the fixture so the check is not vacuous.
durationSec 5→60 strictly increases liter's damage. Proves the 5s bound is load-bearing; RED under a permanent/long-window model.
Re-key lastBullet→shotFired: apply count jumps >2× (6-round magazine ⇒ ≈6×). RED if the driver keyed it per-shot instead of per-magazine.

Structural: full-charge trigger (shotFired, or chargeCounter threshold 1), target allies, fillGauge pct 14.31. Behavioural (directional, since liter+crown also generate and burst cooldowns can bind): zeroing the fill can never yield MORE full bursts.

spec.kitLine: Recovers 0.59% of user final Max HP
spec.assertion: Some skill1 block carries a heal-flavoured effect OR the line appears in unmodeled.skill1. No heal EVENT kind exists on the stream, so the magnitude is unobservable; the tandem consequence (a heal feeds an ally's `recovery` trigger — crown is in this fixture) is why the line may not be dropped.

Structural: passive / allies / partsDamagePct 3.08 / no duration. Inertness: zeroing the value leaves helm, liter and crown byte-identical — parts are unmodeled on the partless scope-lock boss, so the line must move nothing.

Structural: fullBurstEnter / allies / attackDamagePct 27.87 / durationSec 10 / no ownBurstGate. Behavioural: exactly fbCount×3 applies, and the first apply comes AFTER the first fullBurstStart in the event stream — the only separator from a burstCast keying in this comp (helm is the sole B3, so the two triggers fire on the same rotations but a burstCast apply necessarily precedes the FB window).
stat→atkPct changes helm's total (Damage-Up bucket ≠ ATK bucket); durationSec 10→40 strictly increases it (the 10s window binds, and is not merely co-terminal with Full Burst).

Structural: full-charge trigger, target enemy, no fbGate/requiresCore, flatDamage core:false, noFb absent/false (riders take FB by timing). Behavioural: skill2 damage events outnumber full bursts, every one has rangeApplied===false (+30% range is off for riders), and both inFullBurst true and false occur (non-vacuity). Counterfactuals: atkPct→0 lowers helm only (liter/crown byte-identical); fbGate:'inFb' lowers helm — RED if the driver FB-gated or core-gated the rider.

Structural: burstCast / enemy / flatDamage 8236.8. Behavioural: exactly one burst-slot damage event per full burst, all with fbMajorApplied===false (burst-cast damage lands before the FB window, so it never takes the +50% major) — RED under an FB-boosted or fullBurstEnter-keyed nuke. Zeroing it lowers helm only.

Structural: burstCast / self / chargeDamagePct 158.4 with durationShots 10 and NO durationSec. Behavioural: one apply per burst, targetSlug 'helm' only, durationShots 10 on the event. Counterfactuals: swapping to durationSec 10 changes helm's total (10 rounds on a 6-round magazine spans a reload, ≈17s ≠ 10s) — the classic round-vs-second trap; stat→attackDamagePct changes the total (charge bucket ≠ Damage-Up); teammates stay byte-identical under both (self scope).

spec.kitLine: Recovers 54.45% of atk dmg as HP/10s
spec.assertion: it.skip — no damage-proportional lifesteal primitive in the effect schema and no HP pool in v1, so the payload is unobservable. A live no-silent-drop assertion still requires the line in unmodeled.burst (or a heal-flavoured effect). Flagged consequence: crown's `recovery` trigger is under-fed by helm in-sim.
All three slot arrays exist and are non-empty, every block's own `slot` field matches its key, no `ignored`/`unsupported` effects (validator-rejected), no top-level `blocks` array.

fixtures: controlComp('helm', false) → liter (B1) / crown (B2) / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus helm; 14 hoisted/memoised 180s runs (1 base + 13 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals). The fixed-B3 flag is OFF deliberately: the harness's fixed B3 slot IS helm, so controlComp('helm', true) would put a duplicate slug in the comp and collapse the per-slug totals map. liter + crown still complete the I→II→III chain, so bursts genuinely cast (a lone B3 makes zero Full Bursts) and liter/crown carry nonzero damage, which keeps every inertness assertion non-vacuous. Damage-event filters by srcSlot rely on the premise that liter and crown are pure support kits with no skill2/burst damage blocks (stated in the file header).
gaps: burst — 'Recovers 54.45% of attack damage as HP for 10 sec': it.skip. No lifesteal/damage-proportional-heal primitive in the effect schema and no HP pool in v1; no heal event on the stream, so the payload is unobservable. Replaced by a no-silent-drop assertion (unmodeled.burst must carry the line). Flag: this under-feeds crown's `recovery` trigger in-sim.

skill1 — 'Recovers 0.59% of the skill user's final Max HP': magnitude unobservable (no heal event kind is emitted); asserted only as encoded-or-documented, not by value. Same tandem caveat as the burst line.

skill2 — Full-Burst-enter vs burst-cast trigger identity cannot be separated by APPLY COUNT in any comp I can build from controlComp (helm is the sole Burst III unit, so both triggers fire on identical rotations); the test separates them by event ORDER against fullBurstStart. A second-B3 fixture would be the stronger discriminator and is not reachable through the exposed harness API.

skill1 — the 14.31% gauge fill is asserted only directionally (fbCount cannot rise when zeroed): with liter + crown also generating, burst cooldowns rather than gauge may bind the rotation count, so a strict inequality would risk a false red. The magnitude claim is structural (pct 14.31 on the full-charge block).

skill1 — 'attacking with Full Charge' trigger encoding accepts either shotFired or chargeCounter-with-threshold-1; on a 60f-charge SR every trigger pull is a full charge, so the two are equivalent and I did not pin one.
